description: This file defines CLI commands for browser debugging, including highlighting elements, fetching errors, network requests, and managing traces, with functions for executing commands and handling debug contexts.

methods.name: runBrowserDebug
methods.description: Executes a command with runtime error handling and exit on failure.

methods.name: withDebugContext
methods.description: Runs an action within a debug context, handling setup and error management.

methods.name: printJsonResult
methods.description: Outputs JSON result if parent options specify JSON output.

methods.name: callDebugRequest
methods.description: Makes a browser request with a timeout.

methods.name: resolveProfileQuery
methods.description: Creates a profile query object if profile is specified.

methods.name: resolveDebugQuery
methods.description: Constructs a debug query object with optional parameters.
